# lean-pkg registry wiki

render a Markdown status page.

Also spelled: `lean-pkg wiki` ([all aliases](aliases.md)).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg registry wiki [--out OUT] [--candidates CANDIDATES] [common flags]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--out OUT` | write the Markdown here instead of stdout |
| `--candidates CANDIDATES` | adoption ledger path (default: lean-adoption-candidates.yaml next to the registry) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `wiki` | render a Markdown status page | `[--out PATH]` `[--candidates PATH]` |
